sourceTitle: A refreshed brand and website for a bold new mission, culture and focus on fairness
author: William Joseph
post: Paul Hamlyn Foundation’s brand needed to feel as fair, and as warm, as the relationships behind it. A refreshed identity and a clearer fund finder closed that gap.
alt: Motion graphic about the Paul Hamlyn Foundation brand and website. It shows the published fund finder, with the amount, duration and deadline.

beats.heading: A brand that feels like the relationship
beats.caption: Paul Hamlyn Foundation. A brand that feels like the relationship.

beats.heading: The identity lagged behind the mission.
beats.body: Warm, long-term relationships were not yet visible.
beats.caption: The old identity lagged behind a mission centred on fairness.

beats.heading: We started with both sides of the table.
beats.body: Grantees and the team shaped a shared mission language.
beats.caption: Grantees and the team shaped a shared language for the mission.

beats.heading: Fund finding, in plain language
beats.caption: Show who the fund is for, the amount, the duration and when to apply.

beats.heading: The fund finder, as it shipped
beats.alt: The published Paul Hamlyn Foundation fund finder on a phone, beside cards for the amount, duration and deadline.
beats.caption: The fund finder shows the amount, the duration and when to apply.

beats.heading: A finder should remove a barrier.
beats.body: It should never get in the way.
beats.caption: A fund finder should remove a barrier, not add one.

beats.heading: Built to be used, not only admired.
beats.body: A toolkit the team can carry, on a site applicants can follow.
beats.caption: A visual toolkit the team can use, and a site applicants can follow.

beats.heading: Bold and colourful. Highly accessible.
beats.caption: Bold and colourful, and highly accessible.
